ConfigAuditLog.description_en: Enables or disables the audit log feature and delivers audit logs to buckets
ConfigAuditLog.description_zh: 开通或关闭审计日志、配置审计日志投递Bucket

ConfigBackupRemark.description_en: Configure the name and remark information of a backup
ConfigBackupRemark.description_zh: 配置备份的名称及备注信息

ConfigBackupTask.description_en: Modifies the execution pattern of a backup task
ConfigBackupTask.description_zh: 修改备份任务执行模式

ConfigClusterCertificate.description_en: Configures a certificate for a cluster of hardware security modules (HSMs) outside the Chinese mainland
ConfigClusterCertificate.description_zh: 为非中国内地密码机集群配置证书

ConfigClusterName.description_en: Modifies the name of a cluster

ConfigClusterSubnet.description_en: Modifies a list of vSwitches that are associated with a hardware security module (HSM) cluster
ConfigClusterSubnet.description_zh: 修改集群绑定的交换机列表

ConfigClusterWhitelist.description_en: Modifies the IP address whitelist of a cluster
ConfigClusterWhitelist.description_zh: 修改集群可访问的白名单列表

ConfigImageRemark.description_en: Modifies the remarks for an image

ConfigInstanceIpAddress.description_en: Modifies the virtual private cloud (VPC) endpoint of a hardware security module (HSM)

ConfigInstanceRemark.description_en: Modifies the remark of an instance

ConfigInstanceWhitelist.description_en: Modifies the whitelist for an instance

CopyImage.description_en: Copies an image to another region

CreateCluster.description_en: Creates a cluster by designating an HSM instance as the master HSM
CreateCluster.description_zh: 选择一台密码机作为主密码机创建集群

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the regions that support Cloud Hardware Security Module (CloudHSM)
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询支持加密服务的地域

EnableBackup.description_en: Enables backup for a specified instance
EnableBackup.description_zh: 将备份与指定实例绑定

ExportImage.description_en: Exports an image of a specified Encryption Service instance
ExportImage.description_zh: 导出指定密码机的镜像

GetAuditLogStatus.description_en: Queries the status of the audit log feature in the current region
GetAuditLogStatus.description_zh: 查询当前地域下审计日志开通状态

GetBackup.description_en: Retrieves information about a specific backup

GetCluster.description_en: Queries information about a specified cluster

GetImage.description_en: Retrieves information about a specified image

GetInstance.description_en: Queries information about a specified instance

GetJob.description_en: Retrieves the details of an asynchronous task
GetJob.description_zh: 获取异步任务的详细信息

InitializeAuditLog.description_en: Authorizes the Encryption Service instance to deliver logs
InitializeAuditLog.description_zh: 授权加密服务投递日志

JoinCluster.description_en: Add an HSM instance outside the cluster to the current cluster
JoinCluster.description_zh: 将集群外的一台密码机加入当前集群

LeaveCluster.description_en: Removes a hardware security module (HSM) from the current cluster
LeaveCluster.description_zh: 将集群内的一台密码机移出当前集群

ListBackups.description_en: Retrieves a list of backup sets that meet specified conditions
ListBackups.description_zh: 获取符合查询条件的备份集合

ListClusters.description_en: Retrieves clusters that match the specified query conditions
ListClusters.description_zh: 获取符合查询条件的集群集合

ListImages.description_en: Queries the images that meet the specified conditions
ListImages.description_zh: 查询符合条件的镜像集合

ListInstances.description_en: Retrieves instances that match the specified query conditions
ListInstances.description_zh: 获取符合查询条件的实例集合

MoveResourceGroup.description_en: Moves a resource to a new resource group
MoveResourceGroup.description_zh: 移动资源所在的资源组

ResetBackup.description_en: Disassociates a backup from a hardware security module (HSM)
ResetBackup.description_zh: 将备份与当前实例解绑

RestoreInstance.description_en: Restores instance data from an image
RestoreInstance.description_zh: 使用镜像恢复实例数据

RotateClusterManagedCert.description_en: Rotates a managed certificate for a cluster

SwitchClusterMaster.description_en: Switches the master role in a cluster to a subordinate HSM. This operation is not supported for manually synchronized clusters in the Chinese mainland
SwitchClusterMaster.description_zh: 将集群内一台子密码机切换为主密码机。中国内地手动同步集群不支持此接口

SyncCluster.description_en: Synchronizes the data of hardware security modules (HSMs) in a cluster
